sentences.text:
Mr. Piyush Jain, Public Prosecutor for the respondent-
State.
Heard on the point of admission.
The revision is admitted for final hearing.
Heard on IA No.682/2018 is an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The applicant has been convicted under Section 16(1)(a)
(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo six months SI with fine of Rs.1000/- with default stipulation, vide judgment dated 23.01.2018 passed by First Additional Sessions Judge, Barwani (MP) in Criminal Appeal No.100010/2016.
It is submitted that Courts below have wrongly convicted the applicant.
The Courts below have not properly appreciated the evidence.

The disposal of revision will likely to take a long time, hence,
prayed for suspension of execution of jail sentence.
The prayer is opposed by Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.

Taking into consideration the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, the disposal of revision will likely to take a long time, subject to depositing the fine amount, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, the application is allowed.
It is directed that the jail sentence of the applicant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH, BENCH
